cause_quote: The initial A2A adapter threw `new Error(`peer ${peerName} has no url configured for outbound A2A`)`, which the delivery queue treated as retryable.
user_saw: A reply to an inbound-only A2A peer failed, triggered extra agent turns on retry, and ended up in the dead-letter queue.
summary: The fix makes missing peer URLs and unresolved outbound token references produce typed non-retryable errors so the delivery queue stops after the first attempt.
reasoning: The A2A launch wired the outbound sender into durable delivery and introduced the plain missing-URL error in the same commit. The queue code at launch already retried errors that matched neither a typed permanent rejection nor its text patterns, and the new error matched neither. PR #165021 later added the unresolved-token guard with the same classification mistake.
